titulo: Foursquare co-founder says equity holders saw no returns from the company’s acquisition
resumo_original: Foursquare raised $411 million in funding according to PitchBook data, but its equity holders saw no returns from its final acquisition.

titulo: AI promises productivity, but for managers, it’s mostly a headache for now
resumo_original: More than 50% of managers say they're finding it harder to evaluate employees' work after adopting AI, according to a new survey.

titulo: Heat pump tech is 170 years old. Pascal thinks it’s time for an update.
resumo_original: Refrigerants startup Pascal has a new take on heat pump and cooling tech using a sponge-like material that promises to be 20% more efficient.

titulo: Mach9 raises $34M after pivoting to AI CAD software
resumo_original: The startup initially set out to build better, faster, and cheaper surveying hardware in 2021.

titulo: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
resumo_original: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI running amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.
